credits.title: Daily routine
credits.overview: A bare house made of glass and concrete is inhabited by a woman who repeats routine gestures under the control of a distant gaze. The film is part of the program Mascarilla 19 commissioned and produced by Fondazione In Between Art Film.

credits.title: The World Is Not a Landscape
credits.overview: A quasi-sequel to Michel Houellebecq's novel The Possibility of an Island, Masbedo's short presents a post-apocalyptic landscape overseen by a distant mother nature or perhaps mother of nature portrayed by French icon Juliette Binoche.
